title: Roadmap & Milestones
structural_summary: Uses H1, H2, H3 headings. Content is descriptive text mixed with deeply nested bulleted lists, especially under 'Detailed Task Breakdown'. Some milestones have status indicators and notes.
key_structural_patterns_observed: Strong hierarchical structure of Milestones and Tasks.
Use of status indicators like '(Complete)', '(Current Focus)'.
Tasks sometimes grouped by phase (Design, Implementation, Testing) or Objective.
Implicit task numbering in some sections (e.g., M5.1.1).
notes_for_ai_consumption: The Milestone-Task hierarchy is well-suited for parsing into a structured task management format or knowledge graph. Explicit dependencies and status indicators provide valuable context. The 'Detailed Task Breakdown' section offers granular tasks that can be extracted. Explicit cross-references to other B#.# documents are frequent.
